title: TransferAssessment
description: PACK-09, Framework 0.8.1 section 13.1. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.dataprotection.TransferAssessment). The recorded transfer mechanism and its assessment reference for a processing activity's recipient category. PACK-09 records that an assessment exists and under which mechanism; it does not store the assessment document. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
